rounds.feature: Bounded opt-in pretty XML rendering and decode --pretty CLI output
checks: Twelve pretty-rendering tests cover element-only indentation, direct/mixed/empty/whitespace text, xml:space, depth, output budgets, Unicode, and malformed manually constructed documents.
Four additional CLI tests cover strict option parsing and literal filenames; the CLI package passes 18 tests.
JavaScript and Windows-native CLI corpus verification compares seven compact and seven pretty XML trees, preserving all original text and allowing only inserted element-only separator whitespace.
Independent read-only code review found no material defect.
rounds.limits: Pretty output adds whitespace text nodes; compact output remains the default. Default output budget is 32 Mi UTF-16 units and pretty depth is 256.

rounds.feature: Local literal filtering in Structure and References
checks: Six added frontend tests cover case/space normalization, literal Unicode matching, protocol fields, decimal and padded-hex values, immutable original order, source pages, and pagination bounds.
Actual browser typing retains the search input and focus; zero matches, clear, language/view persistence, new-input reset, and source selection were exercised.
Reference query 0x7f030000 matches two of four references; downloaded JSON deep-equals all four original reference records.

A generated owned-fixture variant contains 1,210 events; Structure retains 1,000 and matches 996 uses-permission events before 50-row pagination. Source offset 49,260 clears the query and reports that its event is outside the preview.
Independent finish review returned SHIP after inspecting code and the final 1440px, 390px, and 723px browser captures.
rounds.limits: Structure search and JSON export remain bounded to the first 1,000 event summaries. Filters do not narrow exports. IME guards were reviewed; a physical IME and physical mobile hardware were not tested.

browser_boundary_fixture.construction: Replace the existing 80-byte uses-permission start/end pair at [1260,1340) with 600 copies and update the outer file-size field.

visual_review.capture_scope: Full-page browser captures, each from scrollY 0; no document-level horizontal overflow. Narrow tables retain local horizontal scrolling. Captures are ignored local review artifacts.
visual_review.detector: One scoped detector run; its Arial warning was reviewed. System UI labels retain Arial while headings use self-hosted Alegreya. This is not a complete accessibility audit.

checks: The deployed module Worker decoded the resource-reference sample.
Query 0x7f030000 displayed two of four reference records.
Downloaded filtered-view JSON deep-equaled all four references from the actual compiled MoonBit bridge.
A Structure uses-sdk query survived switching to References; selecting reference offset 1340 cleared that Structure query, restored 12/12 events, and selected original event index 6.
No warning/error console entries appeared during these checked flows.

scope: Bounded correctness checks and browser flows. Clipboard payload contents, physical mobile devices, and a physical IME were not verified. Mooncakes publication remains separate and unpublished.
